name: BangxBang
source:
Bang x Bang is a NSFW furry homoerotic adventure visual novel, where you are a gangster's son who don't want to be involved in your family business. But your tranquil life became so far gone when the head of Big Wolf gang suddenly came to find you.

[Edited from [url=https://bangxbang.itch.io/bangxbang]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Bang x Bang》是一部含成人内容的男同性恋兽人冒险视觉小说。你是黑帮老大的儿子，却不愿涉足家族生意。然而，当大狼帮的首领突然找上门时，你平静的生活便一去不返了。

[编译自 [url=https://bangxbang.itch.io/bangxbang]Itch.io[/url]]
